title: Fibonacci number
prompt: Write fibonacci(n) that returns the n-th Fibonacci number, where fibonacci(0) = 0, fibonacci(1) = 1, and every later number is the sum of the two before it: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...
hints: Write out the first 10 numbers by hand and look at how each is made from the earlier ones.
To make the next number you only need to remember the last two. How can you update both as you go round a loop?

Plan: keep two variables (the two latest numbers, starting 0 and 1); repeat n times: replace them with (second, first + second); the first one is the answer. If you use recursion, remember it gets very slow for n around 30.

edge_hints.zero: fibonacci(0) is 0, the very first number. Check your starting values.
